text:
maria.g: quick heads-up — planning to unfreeze model v3.1 from the pinlist for a controlled canary tomorrow 13:00 PT. The new embeddings dtype change is included. Need explicit compatibility sign-off from runtime, sdk, and qa teams.

oliver.k: what's the failure mode? did embed dtype change require a new client param or model signature?

maria.g: it changes the default dtype for embeddings from float32 -> float16 for quantized builds. Most infra handles it but we've seen a client deserialise error in one internal app.

sara.qa: can we run the regression harness against canary with a targeted prompt set? I'll queue tests but need the build tag and exact model hash.

maria.g: model hash is sha256:8f3a5c2b4d... (truncated)

deploy-bot: scheduled action: unfreeze 'v3.1' from pinlist in 'canary' at 2026-05-05T20:00Z. To cancel, reply "cancel unfreeze" in thread within 30m.

justin: :eyes: runtime team — do we need a hotfix to accept mixed dtype embeds? If not, we should keep it frozen until after the weekend.

oliver.k: runtime should accept both dtypes at the loader boundary, but some legacy ops expect float32. We pushed a small guard in runtime/loader yesterday (PR #4321). It's in staging only.

amy: SDK note: the python SDK 1.4.2 has a forcing cast to float32 in embeddings.Client.to_numpy(). We'll need a patch or release 1.4.3. I can cut a patch if we unfreeze.

sara.qa: blocking: SDK patch OR runtime fallback. Which do you prefer?

maria.g: prefer SDK patch for quick turnaround — less risk to runtime. But if sdk patch can't ship before canary, we should postpone.

justin: timeline — amy, can you do a quick patch and npm/pypi release within 2 hours? If yes, we can proceed.

amy: yes, I can open the PR now, aim to publish in <=1.5h. Will post the release notes here.

deploy-bot: action queued: unfreeze will proceed at 2026-05-05T20:00Z unless cancelled. Recording owners: releases@redwood; cc: eng-runtime, eng-sdk, qa.

oliver.k: once SDK patch lands, we should run a smoke matrix: python sdk v1.4.3 + runtime staging + v3.1 canary. Sara please confirm when done.

sara.qa: will run matrix and post summary. If any regression >1% fail rate on our prompt set, we'll auto-rollback.

maria.g: sounds good. I'll hold the canary window to 2 hours and monitor metrics. If rollback, procedures: deploy-bot rollback action -> re-add pin -> stop traffic -> notify customers.

amy: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/789 — includes dtype guard and test. Will publish after review.

justin: thanks. tagging release lead to keep eyes on alerts: @oncall-release.

maria.g: thanks team. I'll cancel unfreeze if the SDK publish slips. :thumbsup:
